limitations: Fresh Chrome processes/profiles with HTTP cache disabled do not reset OS, GPU-driver or CDN caches.
Physical iPhone startup/memory/thermal acceptance is separate; desktop mobile emulation and WebKit are not physical-device results.
FPS rows are RAF-paced (frame scheduler renders only from requestAnimationFrame callbacks). Earlier GPU-completion-driven throughput receipts are not comparable and are not part of this receipt.
